comments.text: Greece is more than its famous postcard views. The culture, history, and everyday life make this country truly fascinating. Beautiful documentary! 👏

replies.author: @WhereonEarth4K
replies.text: Thank you for watching, I'm so glad we could capture that deeper side of Greece. 🌿

comments.author: @BestGlobalTravelDocumentary
comments.text: Thank you for such a high-quality and profound documentary! Instead of just presenting glitzy tourist images, the video provides a genuine look at the 'country behind the postcard.' From the historical ups and downs (6:40) and thought-provoking demographic issues (1:00) to the beauty of nature and human kindness (18:49), everything creates a very authentic and touching picture. Thank you for this multidimensional perspective, which helps me appreciate the resilience of the Greek people and the true beauty of this country even more.

comments.author: @geoffmccoll4640
comments.text: Living behind the Post Card in 2026, it is like roasting your own testicles and fallopian tubes, while men and female humans became extinct, except for migrants from else where?

comments.author: @nedzad-h6r
comments.text: A rich history, beautiful islands, spirited people, the sea, wine, and olives—these are my memories from traveling through Greece. Greece is made for relaxation and enjoying life. You created a great video and showcased the very best that Greece and the Mediterranean have to offer.

replies.author: @nedzad-h6r
replies.text: @WhereonEarth4K Thank you for your kind words. I recommend everyone to visit the island of Aegina near Piraeus. On my channel in the Community section there is a travelogue from Athens. It is an amateur travelogue, but very honest and warm.
